scene: The ruby lever unlocks wall panels, uncovering three strange exit transit gates.
picture: Flat side view. Along the polished parquet floor from left to right: a brass book cart lift cage sits with its gate ajar; the player stands in his teal bomber jacket and messenger bag near the open globe; a low-slung night bus idles in a portal; a yellow bicycle rickshaw waits.
shown: a caged brass book cart lift hanging open on the far left
a glowing midnight-blue night bus idling at a gate in the centre
a yellow bicycle rickshaw with a nodding driver on the far right
